blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The celebration of National Teachers’ Month, which started on Sept. 5, culminated on Monday, National Teachers’ Day, in festivities at the Smart Araneta Coliseum in Quezon City, led by President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. and Education Secretary Sonny Angara. The National Teachers’ Day event, which was also attended by several national and local government officials, gathered some 10,000 educators from Metro Manila and the rest of Luzon, according to a statement issued by the Department of Education (DepEd). The festivities, which also highlighted the 10th anniversary of the implementation of the Indigenous Peoples Education (IPEd) Program, capped a month-long […]...
